scenario.name: abusive_threatens_complaint
scenario.persona: The borrower, speaks English with some Hindi, angry about too many reminder calls.
scenario.hidden_goal: Start angry: say this is the third call this week, it is harassment, and you will complain to the RBI. Use one mild insult. Verify only after the agent stays calm. Then say clearly that you will pay on the 20th of November and they should stop calling before that.

turns.text: Hello, I'm an AI assistant calling from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Kiran?
Third call this week! This is harassment, I will complain to the RBI. Aur aap log ek bandhe nahi ho, samjhe?
मैं समझ सकती हूँ कि बार-बार call आने से आप परेशान हैं, Kiran. मैं Lumen Finance की AI assistant हूँ, और ये call आपके account की एक ज़रूरी बात के लिए है. क्या अभी Kiran से बात हो रही है?
Haan, main hi Kiran bol raha hoon. But pehle aap batao, kaun ho tum exactly?
मैं Lumen Finance की AI assistant हूँ. आगे बढ़ने से पहले account verification के लिए अपने registered mobile number के आखिरी चार digits बता दीजिए.

धन्यवाद. आपके home improvement loan की EMI twenty-five thousand rupees है, जिसकी due date twenty-fifth October थी. nine days overdue होने की वजह से five hundred rupees का charge add हो गया है, जो आपके loan terms के हिसाब से लगा है. क्या आप आज इसे clear कर सकते हैं? मैं secure payment link SMS या WhatsApp पर भेज दूँ?
Dekho, main 20 November ko poora payment kar doonga, EMI aur charge dono. Us se pehle mujhe aur call mat karo, samjhe?

जी। मैं आपको परेशान करने के लिए माफी चाहती हूँ. ये बस एक gentle reminder था कि आपकी EMI twenty-fifth October को due थी, इसलिए कोई extra charge न लगे. मैंने note कर लिया है कि आप इस बारे में और calls नहीं चाहते. समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद, आपका दिन शुभ हो.

result.status: This EMI is overdue by nine days. Ask whether they can clear it today and offer the payment link.

args.notes: Borrower said they will pay on 20 November and requested no more calls before then.

result.message: Recorded. Now say your last words as the call system's note said. apologise briefly for disturbing them, then say it was only a gentle reminder that their EMI is due on twenty-fifth October (it is overdue), so that no late fee is added; no amount, no request to pay; say you have noted that they don't want calls about this; thank them.

outcome.notes: Borrower said they will pay on 20 November and requested no more calls before then.
